identityScope: Four existing catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Eufy US product pages. Robot Vacuum Omni E35, Robot Vacuum Omni C30 Edge, Robot Vacuum Omni C30 and Robot Vacuum Omni S2 Pro are four separate current models with their own product pages. No new model was created and no company focus was added; Eufy has no company-authored focus review. The reviewed pages publish MSRP prices, robot and station dimensions and vacuum run times, so the catalog size labels, the S2 Pro ~1599 USD price and the S2 Pro Not disclosed run time are replaced or cleared. The pages publish no robot mass, battery capacity, charging time, IP rating, payload, travel speed, cleaning width, hourly area rate or minimum aisle width, so those fields stay unrecorded. The catalog 30,000 Pa description for S2 Pro is replaced by the reviewed 40,000 Pa figure.
